recognize_zh: 在小淋巴球與組織球的背景中，可見大型細胞的核呈多葉摺疊、像爆米花（popcorn/LP cell），染色質淡而呈泡狀、核仁小且多個，缺乏典型 Reed-Sternberg 細胞那種巨大嗜酸性核仁。
features: Scattered large cells with multilobated, folded 'popcorn' nuclei
Vesicular, pale chromatin with multiple small basophilic nucleoli
Moderate amount of pale amphophilic cytoplasm
Absence of large, inclusion-like eosinophilic nucleoli typical of classic RS cells
Background of small lymphocytes and epithelioid histiocytes with abundant pink cytoplasm
describe_en: Lymph node section at high power shows scattered large atypical cells in a background of small lymphocytes and epithelioid histiocytes. The large cells have multilobated, folded nuclei with vesicular chromatin, multiple small nucleoli, and a moderate amount of pale cytoplasm. Classic Reed-Sternberg cells with large eosinophilic nucleoli are not seen in this field. The findings are consistent with lymphocyte predominant (popcorn) cells of nodular lymphocyte predominant Hodgkin lymphoma; immunohistochemistry (CD20+, OCT2+, CD15-, CD30-) is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: HRS cells have large eosinophilic nucleoli and are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5, whereas LP cells are CD20+, OCT2+, BOB1+ and CD30/CD15-negative.
THRLBCL shows diffuse architecture without CD21-positive follicular dendritic meshworks and a background rich in T cells and histiocytes rather than small B cells.
PTGC contains centroblasts but lacks atypical popcorn cells rimmed by PD-1-positive T-cell rosettes.
